description: Labeled corpus for smart-contract-auditor precision/recall benchmark

contracts.notes: Classic reentrancy: external call before state update, no guard
setOracle without onlyOwner — any caller can overwrite the mutable price source (compound access-control + oracle risk)
pragma ^0.7.6, no SafeMath, arithmetic on uint256
Low-level .call return value ignored, no require(ok)
balanceOf() used as spot price for borrow calculation
tx.origin used for authorization in sensitive functions
CEI ordering + nonReentrant modifier — no reentrancy finding expected
onlyOwner on setOracle — no access control finding expected
pragma ^0.8.17 — built-in overflow protection, no finding expected
Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface with staleness check — no oracle manipulation expected
require(success) after .call — no unchecked return finding expected
